name: fig_learning_matched_rate
caption: Interim monitoring only. Per-image log-rate linear interpolation, four fixed centre crops. No confidence interval or final capacity conclusion. The released anchor has a different training history.

name: fig_qp_and_interpolation
caption: Panel a decomposes the same-QP32 quality difference into the raw difference and the linear log-rate adjustment to each crop's D2 QP32 bitrate. Panel b compares two interpolators at fixed .1/.2/.4 estimated bpp; their difference is sensitivity, not a statistical interval. Both panels use four fixed crops at the same ongoing-training epoch.
